newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain BMB 1996 net profit rises 70 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain BMB 1996 net profit rises 70 pct.

text.p: Bahrain Middle East Bank (BMB) said on Wednesday its 1996 net profit grew to $9.5 million, up 70 percent on a year earlier.
Bahrain-based BMB, an offshore banking unit, made a $5.6 million net profit in 1995.
"This increase in profitability primarily reflects higher returns from all areas of the bank's investment banking activites and an improved performance in foreign exchange," a bank statement said.
The bank's investment income rose to a record $14.7 million at end-1996 from $11.9 million at end-1995.
BMB, set up in 1982, is 28.6 percent owned by Burgan Bank SAK of Kuwait. The rest is held by investors in the Gulf.
